title: Will 2023 be the year of mid and small-caps?
text: 2022 was a rough year for global equity markets amid rising rates and the Russia-Ukraine war. But Indian markets managed to recover some ground in the second half of the year. Of all the segments, small-cap was the worst-hit. So what led to a dismal performance of small-caps in 2022 and which segments emerged victorious? Deepak Korgaonkar and Puneet Wadhwa bring the answer in this episode.
